Hey everyone!

Update 1.5 just went live. It's a big one, and it also lays the groundwork for Ashen Creek, the new DLC neighborhood coming August 11. Most of what's below lands in your game today, for free, no DLC required.
The highlight this time is the new Chemist's Workshop: loot chemical samples on your runs, bring them back to your hideout, and cook them into product.
On top of that, scoring got a proper rework. It now factors in stealth, time spent, and more, and the score overview at the end of a run actually shows you where the points came from.
I've also rebuilt the saving system to stop items from disappearing after loading into the map, which I know has been driving some of you crazy.
Added
Chemical samples that can be stolen and used to make drugs.
New furniture: Chemist's Workshop. Make drugs from ingredients found while looting.
New furniture: Mystery Box. Put in loot and get a surprise back, better or worse.
New furniture: Exchange Box. Swap skill leaflets, golden cards, or upgrade modules for a different one of the same type.
New furniture: Trash Bin. Search it once a day for a random item.
New furniture: Forgery Workshop. Duplicate any item, once per quota.

Hi everyone!
Today we’re dropping another major update for Crime Simulator - and this one’s packed.
We’re introducing a brand-new heist, fresh furniture for your base, new golden cards, full truck and tool customization, and a bunch more. Full details below 👇
Ever wondered why RAM prices are so high? Yeah… this place might be the reason.

Computer components are being funneled into this facility to train and improve advanced AI systems. Rumor has it that two humanoid AI robots patrol the main building - and they’re way tougher than any human you’ve faced so far.

Hi everyone,
Today we’re releasing the beta version of the Lobbies update.
This update introduces game lobbies along with a lobby browser in the main menu, allowing you to join any session that’s set to public.

Instead of inviting players directly to your hideout, you’ll now start in a lobby. From there, you can invite friends or make your lobby public and wait for others to join. Once everyone’s ready, you’ll all enter the hideout together.
This new flow fixes the black screen issue that could occur with large inventories and high ping, and it also makes it much easier to find people to play with.
Please note that the beta uses separate beta save files. If we don’t receive any major bug reports or complaints over the next week or so, we’ll move forward with a full public release.

Hi everyone - great news! Version 1.3 is now live for everyone 🎉
This update adds new loot, a purchasable hideout expansion, PvP competition modes, PS5 controller support, some location reworks, and plenty more to dig into.

I also want to wish you all a Merry Christmas. It’s been a really interesting year, and I’m excited to keep building on the game with more updates, and possibly even some DLCs in 2026. Thanks for being part of the journey.

Hi everyone, I wanted to make a small update on the demo and also show some new stuff.
As for the demo, the game itself is finished but we're waiting for 3 things: new banner, new trailer and translations for the game. Hopefully we will be able to release it in February.

As for the full game, the development is going very good. If all goes according to plan and I don't get hit by a car, there's about 80% chance the game will release this year. The price will also be way lower than Thief Simulator 2.
Time to show some new stuff.
Once you reach New game +1, you will unlock ability vouchers, as well as the voucher machine, which must be purchased at your computer.

Currently you receive ability vouchers for completing quotas. There are 4 abilities in total, each one provides a different kind of a bonus - for example, you can call off a policeman if things get too heated, but only once per game.
Aside from unlocking abilities, you may also receive gift vouchers for playing the game. They can grant you random rewards, like new golden cards, tools, loot and more.
Now you can order a cloth closet on the computer and change your looks. It's a bit more modular than the prologue, instead of changing the whole player model, you can change parts of it.
I was unsure about the comeback of this mechanic since so many things have changed, but ultimately it's back.
You can throw your crowbars and baseballs at people, knocking them out pretty good.
You can also throw them at your friends if you don't like them.
For now that's it - if things keep moving as they are, we're gonna see a full release this year. ːsteamthisː
